QuestionText: Which THREE AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspectives focus primarily on technical capabilities? (Choose 3.)
Explanation: AWS CAF svrstava Platform, Security i Operations među perspektive usmjerene na tehničke sposobnosti; Business, People i Governance pokrivaju poslovne sposobnosti.

QuestionText: A CFO wants to confirm that cloud investments advance measurable business outcomes. Which AWS CAF perspective should lead this work?
Explanation: Business perspektiva povezuje ulaganja u cloud s poslovnom strategijom i mjerljivim ishodima.

QuestionText: A company must retrain staff and adapt its culture before a cloud migration. Which AWS CAF perspective addresses this?
Explanation: People perspektiva bavi se kulturom, vještinama, organizacijom i promjenom radne snage.

QuestionText: The executive team wants oversight of cloud programs and their transformation risks. Which AWS CAF perspective fits best?
Explanation: Governance perspektiva koordinira cloud inicijative, upravlja rizicima i prati ostvarenje koristi.

QuestionText: An engineering group is building a standardized, scalable cloud landing platform for application teams. Which AWS CAF perspective is most relevant?
Explanation: Platform perspektiva ubrzava isporuku cloud opterećenja kroz skalabilno okruženje i zajedničke platformne sposobnosti.

QuestionText: A CISO is defining controls for confidentiality, integrity, and availability during migration. Which AWS CAF perspective leads this work?
Explanation: Security perspektiva AWS CAF usmjerena je na povjerljivost, integritet i dostupnost podataka i opterećenja.

QuestionText: An operations team must define how cloud services will be monitored and run to meet business needs. Which AWS CAF perspective applies?
Explanation: Operations perspektiva obuhvata pružanje i rad cloud usluga na nivou koji ispunjava poslovne potrebe.

QuestionText: Which TWO are business outcomes described by AWS CAF? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: AWS CAF navodi smanjenje poslovnog rizika i poboljšanje ESG učinka kao moguće ishode cloud transformacije, ne kao bezuslovne garancije.

QuestionText: A company wants a structured way to assess its cloud readiness and prioritize transformation opportunities. Which AWS framework should it consult?
Explanation: AWS CAF pomaže procjeni spremnosti, prioritetima i razvoju plana cloud transformacije.

QuestionText: A legacy application cannot move yet because of an unresolved dependency on specialized local hardware. Which of the seven migration strategies applies for now?
Explanation: Retain znači ostaviti aplikaciju u postojećem okruženju dok zavisnosti ili poslovni razlozi sprečavaju migraciju.

QuestionText: A company moves a large set of virtual machines to a cloud version of the same platform without changing the applications. Which migration strategy is this?
Explanation: Relocate prenosi opterećenja na cloud verziju platforme bez prepisivanja aplikacija ili bitne promjene operativnog modela.

QuestionText: A company redesigns a monolithic application into cloud-native components to use new capabilities. Which migration strategy describes this?
Explanation: Refactor ili re-architect podrazumijeva značajnu promjenu arhitekture radi iskorištavanja cloud mogućnosti.

QuestionText: Which TWO situations match the migration strategy named replatform? (Choose 2.)
Options: Move a self-managed database to Amazon RDS with modest application changes
Adopt a managed runtime without redesigning the whole application
Move unchanged virtual machines to EC2
Explanation: Replatform uvodi ciljane optimizacije, poput upravljane baze ili runtime-a, bez potpunog redizajna aplikacije.

QuestionText: Before selecting migration waves, a team maps application dependencies and usage across its data center. What is the main purpose of this discovery?
Options: Choose suitable migration strategies and sequence dependent workloads
Guarantee that every application can be rehosted unchanged
Eliminate the need for a business case
Explanation: Procjena portfelja i međuzavisnosti služi izboru odgovarajuće strategije iz 7 Rs i planiranju redoslijeda migracije.

QuestionText: A phased migration moves one group of dependent applications at a time instead of every workload in one cutover. What does this approach primarily help manage?
Explanation: Migracijski talasi se planiraju prema zavisnostima i složenosti kako bi se smanjili rizik i prekidi.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements correctly compare rehosting and refactoring? (Choose 2.)
Options: Refactoring means leaving the workload on premises
Rehosting always creates a new SaaS subscription
Rehosting typically makes few application changes
Refactoring may redesign the application to use cloud capabilities
Explanation: Rehosting premješta aplikaciju uz malo promjena, dok refactoring mijenja arhitekturu za cloud mogućnosti.

QuestionText: A company must include its existing software licenses in the migration business case. What does BYOL mean?
Options: Ignore license costs in total cost of ownership
Bring eligible existing licenses to the cloud subject to vendor and AWS terms
Buy all licenses only through AWS Marketplace
AWS automatically grants every commercial license
Explanation: BYOL znači upotrebu postojećih podobnih licenci u AWS-u pod primjenjivim licencnim pravilima.

QuestionText: A cloud estimate includes the software license in the hourly service price. How does this differ from BYOL?
Options: The license is included rather than supplied separately by the customer
The customer must own the data center
The service becomes free after one year
Explanation: Kod license-included modela cijena obuhvata licencu, dok BYOL koristi zasebnu postojeću podobnu licencu korisnika.

QuestionText: Which THREE cost categories belong in an on-premises total cost of ownership (TCO) estimate? (Choose 3.)
Explanation: TCO vlastitog data centra uključuje hardver, električnu energiju/hlađenje, prostor i održavanje. Ove stavke treba uporediti s cloud troškovima.

QuestionText: An EC2 fleet is consistently underutilized. Which action best illustrates right-sizing?
Options: Move every workload to the most expensive Region
Select smaller instance types that still meet measured performance needs
Add more large instances without measuring demand
Explanation: Right-sizing usklađuje veličinu resursa sa stvarnim zahtjevima i smanjuje plaćanje neiskorištenog kapaciteta.

QuestionText: A company replaces manual server setup with repeatable automated provisioning. Which TWO benefits are most directly expected? (Choose 2.)
Options: A guarantee of zero security risk
Explanation: Automatizacija smanjuje ručni rad i povećava ponovljivost procesa; ne uklanja sama po sebi troškove ili rizike.

QuestionText: Which expense is most clearly a variable cloud operating expense rather than an upfront capital expense?
Options: Purchase of racks and cooling equipment
Purchase of servers for a new data center
Monthly charges for compute actually consumed
Explanation: Korišteni cloud kapacitet se obično naplaćuje kao promjenljiv operativni trošak; kupovina fizičke infrastrukture je kapitalno ulaganje.

QuestionText: Which cost remains relevant when moving a workload from a company-owned data center to AWS?
Options: Application operations and data transfer charges
Paying AWS facility electricity bills directly
Explanation: Migracija uklanja korisnikovo vlasništvo nad AWS fizičkom infrastrukturom, ali operativni i potrošni cloud troškovi ostaju.

QuestionText: A workload is idle each night but the team has provisioned servers for peak demand 24 hours a day. Which cloud practice can reduce waste?
Options: Scale down or stop resources during idle periods
Use a larger fixed server permanently
Explanation: Usklađivanje kapaciteta s potražnjom smanjuje plaćanje neiskorištenih resursa; treba provjeriti da resursi podržavaju zaustavljanje ili skaliranje.

QuestionText: A company wants to compare a three-year AWS plan against replacing its local servers. Which approach produces the most useful business comparison?
Options: Compare only the initial EC2 hourly price with the server purchase price
Compare total costs across both options using consistent assumptions
Assume cloud services have no ongoing charges
Explanation: TCO poređenje traži iste vremenske granice i sve relevantne troškove, uključujući infrastrukturu, rad i korištenje.

QuestionText: A team is reviewing how identities, data, and systems are protected in its AWS workload. Which Well-Architected pillar is primary?
Explanation: Security pillar obuhvata zaštitu podataka, sistema i imovine te upravljanje sigurnosnim rizicima.

QuestionText: An application team wants better visibility into operations and a repeatable process for learning from incidents. Which Well-Architected pillar applies?
Explanation: Operational Excellence usmjerava rad, nadzor i stalno poboljšavanje procedura opterećenja.

QuestionText: Which pillar asks whether a workload can recover from infrastructure disruption and keep meeting its intended function?
Explanation: Reliability obuhvata dosljedno izvršavanje funkcije opterećenja i oporavak od poremećaja.

QuestionText: A workload delivers correct results but its selected compute resources are inefficient for the current traffic pattern. Which pillar should guide the resource choice?
Explanation: Performance Efficiency traži efikasnu upotrebu compute resursa uz održavanje performansi pri promjeni potražnje.

QuestionText: A company wants to deliver required business value at the lowest sustainable resource cost. Which Well-Architected pillar is most relevant?
Explanation: Cost Optimization usmjerava uklanjanje rasipanja i izbor isplativih resursa uz ispunjenje poslovnih zahtjeva.

QuestionText: Which TWO practices align with the Sustainability pillar? (Choose 2.)
Options: Run oversized idle servers without measurement
Replicate every object in every Region by default
Explanation: Sustainability podstiče veće iskorištenje kapaciteta i manju potrošnju resursa po jedinici rada.

QuestionText: Which THREE items are AWS Well-Architected pillars? (Choose 3.)
Explanation: Reliability, Security i Sustainability su tri od šest zvaničnih Well-Architected stubova.

QuestionText: A company stores backups that must be recoverable years later, while its live site must remain reachable most of the time. Which pairing matches these requirements?
Options: Agility for backups; elasticity for the live site
Cost optimization for both with no other concern
Durability for backups; availability for the live site
Availability for backups; durability for DNS
Explanation: Durability opisuje očuvanje podataka, a availability vrijeme kada je usluga dostupna korisnicima.

QuestionText: A service must continue after a single component fails. Which design practice most directly reduces the single point of failure?
Options: Use one instance for every tier
Use redundant components in separate failure domains
Increase only the disk size of one server
Explanation: Redundancija u odvojenim domenima otkaza smanjuje vjerovatnoću da kvar jedne komponente zaustavi uslugu.

QuestionText: A retailer launches the same application near customers in two continents. Which TWO factors should it evaluate when choosing Regions? (Choose 2.)
Options: The color of AWS console icons
The alphabetical order of Region names
Explanation: Izbor Regiona treba uzeti u obzir latenciju korisnika i zahtjeve o lokaciji podataka.

QuestionText: An operations team creates temporary test environments from templates and removes them after each experiment. What is the main cloud advantage illustrated?
Explanation: Resursi na zahtjev i automatizovani šabloni omogućavaju brze eksperimente i ukidanje nepotrebnog okruženja.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements about managed services are generally true? (Choose 2.)
Options: AWS operates more of the underlying infrastructure
The customer still manages its data and access choices
All managed services have identical pricing
The customer must replace AWS hardware
Explanation: Upravljani servisi prenose dio operativnog rada na AWS, dok korisnik i dalje odgovara za podatke, pristup i pravilnu konfiguraciju.

QuestionText: An application has been overprovisioned to handle a rare annual event. Which AWS Cloud property allows capacity to be released after the event?
Explanation: Elastičnost podrazumijeva skaliranje i naviše i naniže prema potražnji, pa se privremeni kapacitet može osloboditi.

QuestionText: Which situation is an example of capital expenditure for an on-premises data center?
Options: Buying racks and servers before they are used
Paying for consumed S3 storage each month
Paying a monthly AWS data transfer bill
Explanation: Unaprijed kupljeni fizički serveri i oprema su kapitalni troškovi.

QuestionText: A company wants to spread the benefit of AWS scale across many customers. What explains AWS ability to lower unit prices?
Options: Each customer buying its own facility
A requirement to reserve every service for three years
Explanation: AWS agregira potražnju velikog broja korisnika, što stvara ekonomiju obima i može smanjiti jedinične troškove.

QuestionText: A licensing review finds an application can either use an eligible existing license or buy a license-included AWS offering. What is the first decision to make?
Options: Compare license terms and total cost for the workload
Explanation: AWS vodič za cloud ekonomiku razlikuje BYOL i uključene licence; podobnost i ukupni trošak zavise od pravila dobavljača i opterećenja.

QuestionText: Why should a migration business case include cooling and power, even though they are not application code costs?
Options: AWS always bills the customer directly for a data-center utility meter
They replace all AWS service charges
They are real on-premises infrastructure costs in TCO
Explanation: TCO obuhvata troškove rada vlastite infrastrukture, uključujući struju i hlađenje.

QuestionText: An organization measures cloud readiness across workforce, security, platform, and governance before creating a migration roadmap. Which framework organizes these areas?
Explanation: AWS CAF grupiše sposobnosti u šest perspektiva koje pomažu procjeni spremnosti i planiranju transformacije.

QuestionText: Which TWO AWS CAF perspectives are primarily business-oriented? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: People i Governance su među poslovno usmjerenim perspektivama AWS CAF; Platform, Security i Operations su tehničke.

QuestionText: A company wants to increase revenue through faster product innovation after cloud adoption. How does AWS CAF describe this?
Options: A guaranteed result of every migration
Explanation: AWS CAF navodi rast prihoda kao mogući ishod digitalne transformacije, ne kao zagarantovan rezultat.

QuestionText: An application is moved unchanged to cloud-hosted virtual machines, and modernization is planned for a later phase. Which TWO statements are accurate? (Choose 2.)
Options: The application has already been refactored
The move is automatically a SaaS repurchase
Explanation: Rehosting premješta aplikaciju bez promjena; AWS vodič opisuje mogućnost modernizacije nakon početne migracije.

QuestionText: A database remains active on premises while its target in AWS is prepared. Which approach helps keep the target synchronized until cutover?
Options: Stopping all writes for the entire project
A one-time static screenshot of the database server
Explanation: Kontinuirana replikacija prenosi kasnije promjene izvora na cilj i pomaže smanjiti prekid pri završnom prebacivanju.

QuestionText: A team optimizes image processing so that each request uses fewer compute resources without lowering quality. Which TWO Well-Architected goals may this support? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: Manja potrošnja resursa po zadatku može smanjiti trošak i uticaj na životnu sredinu.

QuestionText: A company expects demand in a new market but does not know whether the launch will succeed. Which TWO cloud traits reduce the commitment risk? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: Nabavka kapaciteta po potrebi i njegovo oslobađanje smanjuju rizik ulaganja prije nego što je potražnja poznata.

QuestionText: Which comparison best separates agility from elasticity in cloud computing?
Options: Agility is physical durability; elasticity is a support plan
Agility is data encryption; elasticity is identity management
Agility is speed of change and experimentation; elasticity adjusts capacity to demand
Explanation: Agility označava brzinu promjene i eksperimentisanja; elasticity prilagođava kapacitet stvarnoj potražnji.

QuestionText: An AWS Organizations SCP denies Amazon EC2 in a member account, but an IAM role there allows ec2:RunInstances. What is the effective result?
Options: The IAM allow overrides the SCP
The management account pays for the launch automatically
The launch is denied by the SCP
Explanation: SCP ograničava maksimalne dozvole naloga članice; IAM dozvola ne može zaobići zabranu iz SCP-a.

QuestionText: A company attaches a restrictive SCP to its organization root. Which account is NOT affected by that SCP?
Options: An account in a child OU
Explanation: SCP ne utiče na korisnike i uloge u management nalogu; ograničenja se primjenjuju na naloge članice.

QuestionText: Which TWO activities does AWS Security Hub CSPM perform? (Choose 2.)
Options: Runs checks against security standards and best practices
Patches the guest operating system on every EC2 instance
Collects findings from supported AWS security services
Replaces IAM identity policies with its own permissions
Guarantees that every compliance requirement is met
Explanation: Security Hub CSPM provjerava kontrole prema standardima i najboljim praksama te prikuplja nalaze podržanih sigurnosnih servisa; ne preuzima korisničke IAM ili EC2 obaveze.

QuestionText: An IAM identity policy allows many actions, but a permissions boundary allows only S3 read actions. What can the identity do under these two policies?
Options: Only actions allowed by both the identity policy and boundary
All actions because boundaries are advisory
Every action in the boundary even if no identity allow exists
Every action in the identity policy
Explanation: Permissions boundary postavlja maksimum za dozvole identiteta; efektivne dozvole su presjek relevantnih dozvola.

QuestionText: A team attaches a policy directly to an S3 bucket to grant a partner account access. What type of policy is it?
Explanation: Bucket policy je politika resursa: vezana je za S3 bucket i navodi kome je pristup dozvoljen.

QuestionText: An IAM user has no policy that allows a specific AWS action. What is the default authorization result?
Explanation: IAM zahtjevi su podrazumijevano zabranjeni dok primjenjiva politika ne doda potrebnu dozvolu.

QuestionText: An identity policy allows an action while a resource policy explicitly denies it. What happens?
Options: Access is granted to root only
Explanation: Izričiti Deny u primjenjivoj politici nadjačava Allow.

QuestionText: A cross-account IAM role can be assumed by a partner only if the role trusts the partner principal. Which policy establishes that trust?
Explanation: Trust policy uloge određuje koji identitet smije preuzeti ulogu; dozvolna politika uloge definiše šta uloga zatim može raditi.

QuestionText: A company uses an external identity provider to authenticate employees before they access AWS accounts. Which concept is this?
Explanation: Federation povezuje vanjski identitet s AWS pristupom bez stvaranja zasebnog dugoročnog IAM korisnika za svaku osobu.

QuestionText: Which credential is normally used by an IAM user for programmatic AWS API requests?
Options: Access key ID and secret access key
Explanation: IAM access key par služi potpisivanju programskih API zahtjeva; treba koristiti privremene kredencijale kada je moguće.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements about IAM groups are true? (Choose 2.)
Options: A group itself cannot sign in
A group replaces an AWS Organizations account
Groups can simplify assigning the same permissions to multiple IAM users
Explanation: IAM grupa služi zajedničkom upravljanju dozvolama korisnika i nije identitet koji se prijavljuje.

QuestionText: An application on AWS Lambda needs to call DynamoDB. Which credential approach is preferred?
Options: Embed root access keys in the function code
Attach an execution role with necessary permissions
Explanation: Lambda execution role daje funkciji privremene AWS kredencijale s potrebnim dozvolama.

QuestionText: Which AWS service issues temporary credentials after an authorized principal assumes an IAM role?
Explanation: AWS STS izdaje privremene sigurnosne kredencijale za sesije uloga.

QuestionText: A company wants to reduce risk from root credentials. Which TWO practices are appropriate? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: AWS preporučuje MFA i izbjegavanje root access ključeva; svakodnevni rad treba koristiti namjenske identitete.

QuestionText: Under the shared responsibility model for Amazon EC2, who patches the guest operating system?
Explanation: Kod EC2 AWS održava osnovnu infrastrukturu, dok korisnik upravlja gostujućim operativnim sistemom.

QuestionText: A company moves from self-managed MySQL on EC2 to Amazon RDS. Which responsibility shifts to AWS?
Options: Choice of who may query the database
Maintenance of the underlying database host and operating system
Explanation: Kod RDS-a AWS upravlja infrastrukturom i host OS-om, a korisnik zadržava odgovornost za podatke i pristup.

QuestionText: For a serverless AWS Lambda workload, which task remains the customer’s responsibility?
Options: Secure application code and configure function permissions
Explanation: AWS upravlja infrastrukturom Lambda servisa; korisnik odgovara za svoj kod, podatke i dodijeljene dozvole.

QuestionText: A company stores confidential files in S3. Which TWO security decisions remain with the customer? (Choose 2.)
Options: Physical security of AWS data centers
How the files are classified and protected
Explanation: Korisnik određuje klasifikaciju podataka i pristup S3 objektima; AWS štiti fizičku infrastrukturu.

QuestionText: A website must encrypt traffic between browsers and its HTTPS endpoint. Which control primarily provides encryption in transit?
Explanation: TLS štiti komunikaciju u prenosu; certifikati se mogu izdavati i upravljati kroz ACM.

QuestionText: An architect must distinguish encryption at rest from encryption in transit. Which option is encryption at rest?
Options: Use HTTPS between a browser and endpoint
Explanation: Enkripcija at rest štiti pohranjene podatke; HTTPS/TLS štiti podatke tokom prijenosa.

QuestionText: A team wants centralized control of encryption keys used by multiple AWS services and auditing of key usage. Which service fits?
Explanation: AWS KMS upravlja ključevima i integriše se s AWS servisima; relevantne KMS radnje mogu se evidentirati u CloudTrail-u.

QuestionText: A developer confuses application secrets with encryption keys. Which pairing is correct?
Options: Secrets Manager stores secrets; KMS manages cryptographic keys
Secrets Manager caches web pages; KMS manages DNS
Explanation: Secrets Manager upravlja tajnama poput lozinki, dok KMS upravlja kriptografskim ključevima.

QuestionText: A public website needs a managed TLS certificate for its Application Load Balancer. Which AWS service is designed for this?
Explanation: ACM izdaje, upravlja i obnavlja podržane javne TLS certifikate za integrisane AWS servise.

QuestionText: A compliance officer needs AWS SOC reports, not a report about the company’s own resource configuration. Which service should they open?
Explanation: AWS Artifact pruža AWS izvještaje i dokumente o usklađenosti, uključujući SOC materijale.

QuestionText: A company requires dedicated hardware security modules in AWS to control its own cryptographic keys. Which service is designed for this?
Explanation: AWS CloudHSM obezbjeđuje namjenske HSM uređaje pod korisnikovom kontrolom za kriptografske operacije i ključeve.

QuestionText: A security team sees unusual API calls and suspicious activity in its account and wants managed threat detection. Which service should it use?
Explanation: GuardDuty analizira odgovarajuće signale i generiše nalaze o potencijalno zlonamjernoj aktivnosti.

QuestionText: A team wants automated checks for vulnerable third-party packages included in supported AWS Lambda functions. Which service provides this?
Explanation: Amazon Inspector Lambda standard scanning pregledava zavisnosti u podržanim Lambda funkcijama i slojevima te prijavljuje poznate ranjivosti paketa.

QuestionText: Which service discovers and classifies sensitive data such as personal identifiers in S3?
Explanation: Macie pronalazi osjetljive podatke u Amazon S3 i izvještava o nalazima.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements correctly distinguish GuardDuty from Inspector? (Choose 2.)
Options: Inspector identifies software vulnerabilities in supported workloads
GuardDuty detects suspicious activity and threats
Explanation: GuardDuty je detekcija prijetnji, a Inspector procjena ranjivosti podržanih opterećenja.

QuestionText: A team must block web requests matching SQL injection patterns before they reach an Application Load Balancer. Which service is appropriate?
Explanation: AWS WAF filtrira HTTP(S) zahtjeve prema pravilima, uključujući obrasce uobičajenih web napada.

QuestionText: A service is exposed to network-layer DDoS attacks. Which AWS offering is automatically available at no added charge?
Explanation: Shield Standard je automatski uključen i štiti od čestih mrežnih i transportnih DDoS napada.

QuestionText: Which AWS offering adds access to the DDoS Response Team for eligible protected resources?
Explanation: Shield Advanced je plaćena napredna DDoS zaštita koja uključuje pristup AWS DDoS Response Team-u.

QuestionText: An organization wants central administration of AWS WAF protections across member accounts. Which service helps with that?
Explanation: Firewall Manager centralno postavlja i upravlja zaštitnim pravilima kroz više AWS naloga i resursa.

QuestionText: Which TWO controls are most appropriate to prevent accidental public access to sensitive S3 objects? (Choose 2.)
Options: Turn off audit logging and alerts
Review bucket policies for least privilege
Grant anonymous read to all objects
Explanation: Block Public Access sprečava mnoge javne grantove, a usko definisane bucket politike ograničavaju pristup.

QuestionText: A security team wants to find S3 buckets and IAM roles shared with principals outside its trust boundary. Which capability should it use?
Explanation: IAM Access Analyzer analizira politike resursa i prijavljuje vanjsko ili javno dijeljenje.

QuestionText: A team wants to preview whether a new bucket policy would expose a resource to the public before deployment. Which tool can help?
Explanation: IAM Access Analyzer može provjeriti uticaj politike na javni i cross-account pristup prije primjene.

QuestionText: An auditor asks whether a resource’s configuration changed and whether it complies with a defined rule. Which service answers this?
Explanation: AWS Config prati konfiguracione promjene resursa i procjenjuje usklađenost s pravilima.

QuestionText: A security analyst needs to know which principal deleted an IAM role yesterday. Which service records the API action?
Explanation: CloudTrail evidentira API aktivnost i identitet pozivaoca za reviziju.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements correctly separate CloudTrail and CloudWatch? (Choose 2.)
Options: CloudWatch collects metrics and supports alarms
Explanation: CloudTrail daje reviziju API događaja, a CloudWatch metrike, logove i alarme.

QuestionText: A company wants AWS security controls to meet an industry regulation. Which statement about shared responsibility is correct?
Options: AWS compliance reports support the customer, but the customer must configure its own workload appropriately
A customer never needs its own controls on managed services
Industry requirements apply only to physical data centers
AWS certifications automatically certify every customer application
Explanation: AWS dokazi o usklađenosti pokrivaju AWS kontrole; korisnik ostaje odgovoran za primjenjive kontrole svojih podataka i aplikacija.

QuestionText: An organization is choosing a Region for regulated records. Which TWO considerations are relevant to data residency? (Choose 2.)
Options: The order of EC2 instance types
The Region in which data is stored
The name of the IAM user
Explanation: Za lokaciju podataka važni su izabrani Region i eventualno kopiranje podataka u drugi Region.

QuestionText: A developer wants AWS to rotate a database password automatically and let the application retrieve it securely. Which service is purpose-built for this?
Explanation: Secrets Manager čuva i može automatski rotirati podržane tajne, uključujući kredencijale baze.

QuestionText: Which TWO items should an IAM access review examine to enforce least privilege? (Choose 2.)
Options: The color of the AWS console theme
Permissions actually used by the role
The size of an unrelated S3 object
The number of Availability Zones in a Region
Resources and actions the policy allows
Explanation: Najmanje privilegije traže upoređivanje stvarno potrebnih radnji s opsegom dozvola u politici.

QuestionText: A company uses AWS IAM Identity Center to assign workforce access to many accounts. Which benefit is primary?
Explanation: IAM Identity Center centralizuje identitete, prijavu i dodjelu pristupa AWS nalozima.

QuestionText: A team creates separate AWS accounts for production and experimentation. Which security goal does this account separation help achieve?
Options: Remove the need for IAM policies
Limit the blast radius and isolate environments
Explanation: Odvojeni nalozi stvaraju granice pristupa i pomažu izolaciji okruženja, iako i dalje traže pravilne kontrole.

QuestionText: A managed service stores data for a customer. Who decides whether that data is public, confidential, or regulated?
Explanation: Korisnik klasifikuje svoje podatke i bira odgovarajuće kontrole čak i kada AWS upravlja osnovnim servisom.

QuestionText: A company needs evidence of the current IAM users and their MFA and access-key status. Which IAM report provides this inventory?
Explanation: IAM credential report popisuje IAM korisnike i stanje njihovih kredencijala, uključujući MFA i pristupne ključeve.

QuestionText: Which THREE controls protect different layers of a public web application? (Choose 3.)
Options: AWS Artifact for application firewall rules
AWS WAF for HTTP request filtering
Explanation: Security groups kontrolišu mrežni saobraćaj instanci, WAF HTTP zahtjeve, a Shield DDoS napade.

QuestionText: A team wants to know whether a security control is preventive or detective. Which pairing is correct?
Options: S3 Block Public Access is preventive; GuardDuty is detective
GuardDuty is preventive; S3 Block Public Access is detective
Explanation: Block Public Access sprječava određene javne dozvole, dok GuardDuty otkriva sumnjivu aktivnost i iznosi nalaze.

QuestionText: A policy should permit an AWS action only when a request meets a specified context, such as an allowed source network. Which IAM policy element expresses that restriction?
Explanation: Condition dio IAM politike provjerava kontekst zahtjeva, na primjer izvorni IP, uz ostale dozvole politike.
